biotools.summary: GraphCompass is a set of omics-adapted graph analysis methods for quantitatively evaluating and comparing the spatial arrangement of cells across different conditions. It builds upon Squidpy and provides statistical approaches and visualization functions for analyzing spatial organization in biological samples.
